---
name: Docs request
about: Something in the docs, planning corpus, or wave reports is wrong, missing, or confusing.
title: "[docs] "
labels: ["documentation", "triage"]
assignees: []
---

## What you were trying to do

<!-- The task that sent you to the docs. Understanding this helps us fix the
right level of the docs, not just the one sentence you hit. -->

## Which file / section

<!-- File path + heading or line number. For spec docs, also include the
numbered section (e.g. "docs/PERSONA-SCHEMA.md §3b"). -->

## What is wrong or missing

- [ ] Factual error (claim disagrees with code)
- [ ] Outdated content (was true at some earlier wave, not anymore)
- [ ] Missing content (the doc is silent on something it should cover)
- [ ] Confusing / ambiguous (correct in theory, but easy to misread)
- [ ] Broken link
- [ ] Other:

## Suggested correction

<!-- A sentence, a rewritten paragraph, or a link. If you're comfortable
opening a PR yourself, say so — small doc PRs are the friendliest first
contribution. -->

## Environment (only if relevant)

- Commit SHA: (from `git rev-parse HEAD`)
- Rendered where: (GitHub web, local `grip`, IDE preview, printed PDF, etc.)

## Extra context

<!-- Screenshots of the rendered doc, quotes from conflicting sources, or
notes on what you expected the doc to say. -->
